row: The Feline Veterinary Medical Association (FelineVMA) improves the health and welfare of cats by supporting high standards of practice, continuing education, and scientific investigation. The FelineVMA has a long-standing reputation and track record in the veterinary community for facilitating high standards of practice and publishes guidelines for practice excellence which are available to veterinarians at the FelineVMA website. Find more details at www.catvets.com.
